tagline: Serving with Care, Guided by Love
about_tagline: About Us - Professional Chiropractic & Rehabilitation Center
about_desc1: Lohas Medical is committed to providing comprehensive health management and spinal rehabilitation services. We combine modern chiropractic care, pain rehabilitation, and traditional Chinese orthopedics to tailor the most suitable treatment plan for every patient.
about_desc2: Our team consists of registered practitioners with extensive clinical experience, equipped with advanced diagnostic and treatment facilities designed to help you get rid of chronic pain and restore optimal physical condition.
vision_1: Patient-centered care with precise, personalized treatment plans
vision_2: Combining non-surgical, drug-free natural rehabilitation therapies
vision_3: Continuous follow-up on recovery progress to prevent recurrence
pain_rehab_desc: In-depth treatment and physical rehabilitation for chronic pain such as sciatica, stiff neck and shoulders, and back pain.
spinal_desc: Using professional chiropractic techniques to adjust misaligned vertebrae, restoring nervous system conduction and posture balance.
postpartum_desc: Pelvic repair, rectus abdominis separation repair, and holistic conditioning programs tailored for postpartum mothers.
orthopedics_desc: Combining traditional bone-setting, acupuncture, and Chinese medicine to promote blood circulation and accelerate joint and muscle injury recovery.
foot_desc: Podiatric biomechanical evaluation and custom orthotic insoles for flat feet and plantar fasciitis.
posture_desc: Correcting uneven shoulders, hunchback, forward head posture, and other poor postures to rebuild a healthy, upright physique.
psych_desc: Providing professional mental health counseling to relieve stress and anxiety, promoting overall mind-body balance.
nutrition_desc: Customized anti-inflammatory and body-repairing dietary plans to boost immunity from the inside out.
